Solution 3 (it happens to be similar to Solution 2) is inspired by an idea by feliz shown on the web page https://artofproblemsolving.com/community/c6h21154p137323 The author calls their text a solution, but it is quite confused, so I would not call it a good solution. The idea though is good and nice, and it yields a nice solution.
